items.quote: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
items.claim: According to the text (17:17), Abraham fell on his face and laughed. Privately, he doubted that a man of one hundred and a woman of ninety could have a child.
items.action: fell upon his face, laughed, and inwardly questioned
items.object: the promise of a child to himself and Sarah

items.quote: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
items.claim: According to the text (17:18), Abraham asked God that Ishmael might live before him.

items.quote: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed
items.claim: According to the text (17:19), God stated that Sarah, Abraham's wife, would truly bear him a son.
items.object: a son to be born to Sarah and Abraham

items.quote: and thou shalt call his name Isaac
items.claim: According to the text (17:19), God told Abraham to name the promised son Isaac.

items.quote: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.
items.claim: According to the text (17:19), God said he would establish an everlasting covenant with Isaac and with Isaac's descendants.
items.action: declared the establishment of a covenant
